serverInfo.name: @getmcpads/linkedin-ads-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: LinkedIn Ads MCP server: 18 read tools, 15 opt-in preview-first writes.

tools.name: linkedin_health_check
tools.title: linkedin health check
tools.description: Read-only LinkedIn Ads health check. Confirms the token works, lists which configured ad accounts it can reach, checks the reporting endpoint and reports the API version header in use, without ever returning the token itself.

adAccountId.description: Optional configured account to probe for reporting access. Defaults to the first reachable one.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_list_ad_accounts
tools.title: linkedin list ad accounts
tools.description: List the LinkedIn sponsored ad accounts configured in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS that the authenticated member can reach, with currency, status and serving status. Accounts outside the configured list are never returned. Test accounts are excluded unless asked for.

adAccountIds.description: Configured account IDs to list. Defaults to every configured account.

status.description: Keep only accounts in these native statuses.

includeTestAccounts.description: Test accounts never serve and never report. Off by default.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_account_details
tools.title: linkedin get account details
tools.description: Read one LinkedIn ad account in full, with the members who hold a role on it. Roles decide what the connection can do, so a read that fails on one account and works on another is usually a role, not a scope.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

includeUsers.description: Also list the account users and their roles. On by default.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_campaign_groups
tools.title: linkedin get campaign groups
tools.description: List campaign groups in a LinkedIn ad account, with budget, schedule and serving status. On LinkedIn the campaign group is where a shared budget and a bid strategy live, so it is the level that explains why sibling campaigns stopped together.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

status.description: Keep only campaign groups in these native statuses.

name.description: Exact campaign group names to match.

pageSize.description: Maximum items in this page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description: Opaque nextPageToken from the preceding response; omit for the first page.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_campaigns
tools.title: linkedin get campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns in a LinkedIn ad account with status, objective, format, bid strategy, budget and schedule. On LinkedIn the campaign holds the targeting and the bid, and the creatives under it are the ads.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

status.description: Keep only campaigns in these native statuses.

type.description: Keep only these campaign formats, such as TEXT_AD or SPONSORED_UPDATES.

campaignGroupId.description: Keep only campaigns in this campaign group of the selected account.

includeTargeting.description: Return the raw targetingCriteria object. Off by default because it is verbose.

pageSize.description: Maximum items in this page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description: Opaque nextPageToken from the preceding response; omit for the first page.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_creatives
tools.title: linkedin get creatives
tools.description: List the creatives of a LinkedIn ad account, optionally for given campaigns. A creative is the ad itself, and it carries its own intended status, its review verdict and the reasons it is being held back.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

campaignIds.description: Sponsored campaign IDs or URNs in the selected account.

intendedStatuses.description: Filter by native configured ad statuses, not effective delivery status.

includeContent.description: Return the raw content object of each creative. Off by default.

pageSize.description: Maximum items in this page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.

pageToken.description: Opaque nextPageToken from the preceding response; omit for the first page.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_insights
tools.title: linkedin get insights
tools.description: Run a LinkedIn Ads report grouped by one pivot. This is the analytics finder: one pivot, any granularity, and up to 20 fields including dateRange and pivotValues. Ratios such as CTR, CPC and CPM do not exist in the API and are computed here from the raw terms.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

campaignIds.description: Restrict reporting to these campaign IDs or URNs in the selected account.

campaignGroupIds.description: Restrict reporting to these owned campaign-group IDs.

creativeIds.description: Restrict reporting to these owned creative IDs.

pivot.description: Grouping. Defaults to CAMPAIGN. One of: ACCOUNT, CAMPAIGN_GROUP, CAMPAIGN, CREATIVE, COMPANY, SHARE, CONVERSION, MEMBER_COMPANY, MEMBER_COMPANY_SIZE, MEMBER_INDUSTRY, MEMBER_SENIORITY, MEMBER_JOB_TITLE, MEMBER_JOB_FUNCTION, MEMBER_COUNTRY_V2, MEMBER_REGION_V2, MEMBER_COUNTY, SERVING_LOCATION, PLACEMENT_NAME, IMPRESSION_DEVICE_TYPE, EVENT_STAGE, CARD_INDEX, CONVERSATION_NODE, CONVERSATION_NODE_OPTION_INDEX.

endDate.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

timeGranularity.description: Defaults to ALL, one row for the whole range.

metrics.description: Metric keys from linkedin://metrics. Defaults to spend, impressions, clicks and the ratios.

sortField.description: Native field used to order the returned rows.

sortOrder.description: Ascending or descending native result ordering.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_run_statistics_report
tools.title: linkedin run statistics report
tools.description: Run a LinkedIn Ads report grouped by up to three pivots at once. This is the statistics finder, the only way to cross campaign with device, or campaign group with serving location, in a single request.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

campaignIds.description: Restrict reporting to these campaign IDs or URNs in the selected account.

campaignGroupIds.description: Restrict reporting to these owned campaign-group IDs.

creativeIds.description: Restrict reporting to these owned creative IDs.

pivots.description: One to three pivots. Order decides the order of pivotValues.

endDate.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

timeGranularity.description: Native reporting aggregation interval. Defaults to ALL.

metrics.description: Metric keys from linkedin://metrics. Defaults to spend, impressions, clicks and the ratios.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_demographics
tools.title: linkedin get demographics
tools.description: Break LinkedIn delivery down by professional demographics: company, company size, industry, seniority, job title, job function or location. These are the numbers LinkedIn is bought for, and they come with limits the tool states alongside the rows.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

campaignIds.description: Restrict reporting to these campaign IDs or URNs in the selected account.

campaignGroupIds.description: Restrict reporting to these owned campaign-group IDs.

breakdown.description: Which professional demographic to group by.

endDate.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

metrics.description: Defaults to spend, impressions, clicks and CTR. Conversion value, carousel and reach fields are not available here.

resolveNames.description: Resolve the returned URNs to readable names. On by default.

limit.description: Keep only the top rows by impressions. Defaults to 50.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_validate_query
tools.title: linkedin validate query
tools.description: Check a pivot and metric combination against the LinkedIn reporting rules before spending a call on it. Returns the fields that would actually be sent, the ones LinkedIn would drop, and the twenty field ceiling. Makes no request to LinkedIn.

pivots.description: One to three pivots, as a report would group them.

startDate.description: Inclusive start, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days ago.

endDate.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

timeGranularity.description: Native reporting aggregation interval. Defaults to ALL.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_revenue_attribution
tools.title: linkedin get revenue attribution
tools.description: Read the LinkedIn Revenue Attribution Report: pipeline and closed won revenue from the CRM, attributed to LinkedIn advertising. Only answers for accounts whose Business Manager has a CRM connected, and only over a window of 30 to 366 days.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

pivots.description: One to three of ACCOUNT, CAMPAIGN_GROUP and CAMPAIGN. Defaults to CAMPAIGN.

startDate.description: Inclusive start, YYYY-MM-DD. The window must cover 30 to 366 days.

endDate.description: Inclusive end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

campaignIds.description: Restrict reporting to these campaign IDs or URNs in the selected account.

campaignGroupIds.description: Restrict reporting to these owned campaign-group IDs.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: linkedin_get_delivery_status

tools.description: Explain why LinkedIn ads are or are not serving, from the account down to the creative. LinkedIn keeps a user status and a system serving status side by side, and it is almost always the second one that says why nothing is running.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

campaignIds.description: Limit the campaign and creative scan to these campaigns.

includeCreatives.description: Also scan creatives. On by default.

tools.name: linkedin_create_campaign
tools.title: linkedin create campaign
tools.description: Create an inactive (DRAFT) text or sponsored-content campaign. LinkedIn campaigns hold budget, targeting and bid. Audience expansion and the LinkedIn Audience Network stay off. Native compatibility still applies.

adAccountId.description: Selected LinkedIn advertising account, numeric ID. It must be listed in LINKEDIN_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS.

name.description: Name stored in LinkedIn; does not rename source files or organic posts.

campaignGroupId.description: Numeric parent campaign-group ID in the selected account.

type.description: TEXT_AD for text ads, SPONSORED_UPDATES for sponsored image or video posts.

objectiveType.description: Native objective; must be compatible with the campaign type and ad format.

amount.description: Decimal amount in currency units, such as "20.00". Not micros or cents.

currencyCode.description: ISO currency code. It must equal the ad account currency.

dailyBudget.description: Daily budget in currency units, not minor units: amount "20.00" with currencyCode "EUR".

unitCost.description: Maximum bid in account currency units, not cents.

costType.description: Native bidding basis: CPC per click or CPM per thousand impressions.

country.description: Two-letter country code, such as US.

language.description: Two-letter language code, such as en.

locale.description: Two-letter campaign language and country codes.

targetingCriteria.description: Native LinkedIn targeting criteria with facet keys and entity URNs, such as { include: { and: [ { or: { "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations": ["urn:li:geo:105015875"] } } ] } }. Use linkedin_find_targeting first.

end.description: Optional end, UTC epoch milliseconds, later than start.

runSchedule.description: UTC epoch timestamps in milliseconds; optional end must be later than start.

politicalIntent.description: Explicit advertiser declaration; do not infer.

confirm.description: Preview unless true. Apply only after the person explicitly approved this exact change, in an account where their LinkedIn role allows it.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text. Provider fields depend on the selected query.
